description: This Java class 'ICalHandlerFactory' implements a WebDAV request handler factory for iCalendar, acting as a connector between the WebDAV servlet and the 'ICalWorker' class, handling various HTTP methods related to iCalendar processing.

classes.name: ICalHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating WebDAV request handlers specific to iCalendar, mapping HTTP methods to handler functions.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestHandler based on the HTTP method.

methods.name: handleInvalidMethod
methods.description: Handles invalid HTTP methods by logging and sending a 405 error.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Handles HTTP methods that require no action, logs the method, and responds with OK status.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handleGetRequest.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Handles PUT requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePutRequest.

methods.name: doPropFind
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePropFindRequest.
